A Link rewrites a requested path by replacing linkPath with targetPath and
forwards the result to the backing reader. The backing reader normalizes the
path, so a request that contains ".." segments can resolve to a resource
outside targetPath. The returned ResourceFacade then exposes that resource
under the link namespace.

Normalize the rewritten POSIX path and confirm it stays within targetPath
before calling the backing reader. Recheck the returned resource's own path
before wrapping it in a ResourceFacade, in both byPath and byGlob, and drop
glob results that resolve outside the subtree.

The trailing slash that _validatePathMapping requires on targetPath keeps the
boundary check segment-aware, so a sibling such as "/resources/application/"
is not accepted for "/resources/app/". createFlatReader builds a Link with a
trailing-slash targetPath, so it inherits the same
